name: Dhuli Urad Dal
steps: Rinse the urad dal gently, soak for 30 minutes and drain very well. Cut the ginger into fine strips and chop chilli and coriander.
Heat ghee in a wide pan with a lid. Sizzle cumin, add ginger and chilli for 1 minute, then stir in drained dal, turmeric and salt.
Add the measured water, bring to a simmer and cover. Cook on low heat for 18–22 minutes; check gently with a fork and avoid stirring hard, which breaks the grains.
When tender, uncover and evaporate any remaining water over low heat. Rest off heat for 5 minutes, fluff gently and finish with lemon and coriander; the grains should stay separate.
passiveTime: Soak for 30 minutes; rest after cooking for 5 minutes.
notes: Base recipe for 4 adults. Cooking times are estimates; follow the texture and doneness cues. Jain suitability follows your saved ingredient choices.
